newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index extends losses, Slovnaft lower.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index extends losses, Slovnaft lower.

text.p: The Slovak SAX index continued to edge lower in slugish trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday, pulled down 4.2 points to 170.11 mostly on losses to Slovnaft refinery shares.
Brokers said no signs of revival on the bear market have yet appeared.
"Hardly anything happened today which might be mentioned, except a huge fall in Slovnaft," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said. The refinery lost 35 crowns to 700 crowns, on 39 shares traded.
Overall volume decreased to 369,489 shares, from 597,402 shares traded on Friday, while turnover fell to 149.15 million crowns, from 413.04 million.
